source: PHC Core Rules v1.0 (grammar, cost, Flux) + new word list

shapes.stack: 2 glyphs on one tile: lands on an adjacent tile (with PUSH: 8 tiles + range bonus from the stack)
shapes.line: 2-4 tiles in a straight row: fires from the far end along the row; range 4 / 8 / 12 by length + range bonus; hits the first creature
shapes.ring: 3-4 tiles around a centre tile: radius 1 around the centre, or support words on whoever stands on it

grammar.draw_cost: each word's charge, Glyph AP, 1 Flux
grammar.evoke_cost: 1 AP; 1 charge per glyph minus Sigil Core saving, min 1

shape_words.stay: in a Line: the line itself becomes a wall for as long as the glyphs last; in a Ring: the centre
shape_words.spread: in a Line: a 3-tile cone from the far end

grammar.multiple_subjects: allowed if length permits; damage sums, each element's own rider applies

notes: Rules 1.2 (Sigils on the map). LINE, WALL and CONE became shapes; SPARK, PULL and SILENCE replace them. Every number is provisional.

items.text: Heat. Damage 30, Elemental; on a critical the target is Burning.
items.grand: Lava floor: 10 fire damage on entering or starting a turn inside; Burning on a failed Body save.

items.text: Cold. Damage 25, Elemental; target is Slowed (Body save).
items.name: Freeze
items.grand: Ice sheet: difficult ground; a Body save each move or fall Prone.

items.text: Lightning. Damage 30, Elemental; ignores half cover.
items.name: Shock
items.grand: Storm field: 15 damage at turn start to anyone in Medium armour or heavier; robots Stunned.

items.text: Earth. Damage 35, Sigil (physical-like, armour applies).
items.grand: Earthworks: up to 4 half-cover pillars rise where you choose.

items.text: Wind. Damage 15, Sigil; pushes the target 2 tiles.
items.grand: Cyclone: anyone entering is pushed 2 tiles outward; shots through it -5.

items.text: A snap of current. Damage 15, Elemental. The cheapest attack.
items.name: Spark
items.grand: Static: attack rolls of 1-3 inside jam the weapon.

items.text: A shield of 30 on the target (x Sigil multiplier), until the end of combat.
items.grand: Dome: allies inside +2 Defense and a 20 shield at each turn start (does not stack).

items.text: Heals 25 (x Sigil multiplier x Healing given).
items.grand: Spring: allies starting a turn inside heal 10 x Healing multiplier.

items.text: Target is Pinned (Body save).
items.grand: Tar: Pinned on entering (Body save).

items.text: Target is Blinded (Body save).
items.name: Blind
items.grand: Fog: no one inside sees beyond 1 tile.

items.text: Target is Slowed (Body save). No damage.
items.name: Slow
items.grand: Mire: Movement halved inside.

items.text: Target gets a Left Brain Debuff (Brain save).
items.grand: Maze: Brain save at turn start or stagger 1 tile in a random direction.

items.text: Target is Shaken (Heart save).
items.grand: Haunting: enemies inside are Shaken (Heart save each turn).

items.text: The target tile fills with smoke-bots: blocks sight in radius 1.
items.grand: Smoke field: blocks all sight; everyone inside counts as Hidden.

items.text: Lights radius 4 for the scene; reveals Hidden within it.
items.grand: Noon: Hidden revealed; enemies inside -2 to hit.

items.text: No Sigils, Outbursts or prayers for 1 round (Brain save).
items.name: Silence
items.grand: Dead zone: no Sigils, Outbursts or prayers inside, yours included.

items.text: Single target. Damage x1.
items.grand: Gravity well: everything inside is pulled 1 tile toward the staff at turn start.

items.text: Burst of radius 2 at the point of impact. Damage x0.6.
items.grand: Bloom: any spell landing inside spreads 1 more radius.

items.text: Sends the spell out to 8 tiles. Without it, a spell reaches only an adjacent tile.
items.grand: Rampart wind: shots from outside into it -3.

items.text: The spell holds its tile for 2 rounds (plus the Sigil duration bonus).
items.grand: Stasis: conditions inside do not tick down.

items.text: The spell curves around cover: ignores half and full cover against one target. Needs PUSH.
items.grand: Hunting ground: allies' attacks on enemies inside ignore half cover.

items.text: Targets yourself or an ally you touch; replaces PUSH for support words.
items.grand: Sanctuary: an ally inside who would drop to 0 HP stays at 1 instead (once each).

items.text: Drags the target 3 tiles toward the pattern.
items.name: Pull
items.grand: Vortex: enemies within 4 tiles are pulled 1 tile toward the staff at their turn start.

items.text: Repeat the spell at a second target within range. Counts as 1 word for length, 1 Flux extra.
items.grand: Echo field: the first spell each round cast by an ally inside repeats at half effect.
